blocks.text: Gravitational wave space ka stretching aur compressing (khinchna aur dabna) hai; isay do cheezon ke darmiyan length (lambai) ki tabdeeli naap kar dekha ja sakta hai.
Gravitational waves (GWs) asal mein yeh hain:

blocks.title: Gravitational waves
blocks.text: Spacetime (space aur time ka mila hua kapra) mein ripples (lehrein), jo violent (shadeed) cosmic (kaainati) events (waqiaat), jaise black holes ya neutron stars ke takrane, se paida hoti hain, light ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki information (maloomat) saath le jati hain.

blocks.title: Albert Einstein (1879-1955)
blocks.text:
Germany mein paida hone wale theoretical physicist
Duniya ke sab se mashhoor aur influential (asar-andaz) scientists mein se ek.
GWs samajhne ki sab se aasan misal yeh hai:

Agar hum talab mein patthar phenkein to pani ki surface (satah), yani spacetime, par waves banti hain. Yeh waves bahar ki taraf phailti hain aur patthar (cosmic event) ki information saath le jati hain. Kinare par (gravitational wave observatories mein) inhein pakar kar patthar ke hone aur us ki properties (khoobiyon) ka pata chalta hai.
Prediction (peshgoi) aur detection (pata lagana)

Gravitational waves Einstein ki general theory of relativity ki prediction hain, jo observations (mushahidaat) se sabit ho chuki hai, aur universe (kaainat) ke sab se extreme (shadeed) events ko dekhne ka naya darwaza khol rahi hain.

Einstein ki general theory of relativity ke mutabiq gravity koi force nahi balke massive bodies (bhaari ajsaam) ki wajah se spacetime ka curvature (mur jana) hai. Gravity gadde (mattress) mein bane gaddhe jaisi hai: bhaari cheezein apne ird-gird space ko mor deti (warp karti) hain, isi liye hum gravity mehsoos karte hain. (Kitab mein “wrap” chhapa hai; matlab warp, yani morna.)

Gravitational waves ki prediction Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein ki thi. Yeh spacetime ki waves pehli baar 2015 mein detect hui, jab scientists ne is qism ke pehle observation ka announcement (elaan) kiya. Is qism (do objects ke qareeb aate hue) mein waves ki frequency aur amplitude dheere dheere barhte jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke 2015 ki pehli detection do takrate neutron stars se paida hone wali waves thin. Yeh ghalat hai: 14 September 2015 ko LIGO ne jo pehli gravitational waves pakrin woh do black holes ke milne (merger) se aayi thin, jaisa isi kitab ka topic 8.7 bhi kehta hai. Neutron stars ke takrao se waves pehli baar 2017 mein pakri gayin.

Gravitational waves ke context mein Binary System (BS) ka matlab aisa system hai jis mein do compact (bohat ghane) objects, jaise black holes, neutron stars ya white dwarfs, ek doosre ke gird ghoom rahe hon aur gravitational waves emit (kharij) kar rahe hon.

blocks.title: Dr. Nergis Mavalvala
blocks.text: Dr. Nergis Mavalvala Pakistani-American astrophysicist hain jo MIT mein gravitational waves par apne kaam ki wajah se mashhoor hain.
Gravitational waves ki chaar basic types (qismein)
Gravitational waves ki chaar basic types hain, har ek ke sources aur characteristics (khoobiyan) alag hain:
1. Continuous GWs

Jab koi akela bhaari object (jism), jaise neutron star, ek hi speed (raftar) se ghoome (spin kare) to ek hi frequency aur amplitude wali continuous GWs banti hain. White dwarf binary systems bhi continuous GWs banate hain.
2. Compact binary inspiral GWs

Jab binary system, jaise do neutron stars, do black holes, ya ek neutron star aur ek black hole, ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hue andar ki taraf ghoom kar (spiral) qareeb aate hain, to compact binary inspiral GWs banti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne “Inspirational” likha hai. Sahi lafz “inspiral” hai: do objects gravitational waves mein energy khote hue chakkar kha kar ek doosre ke qareeb aate (spiral in) hain. “Inspirational” ka matlab hausla dene wala hai, jo yahan ghalat hai.
3. Burst GWs
Yeh violent (shadeed) events, jaise supernova (sitare ka phatna), gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings, se paida hoti hain.

blocks.title: BS Model
blocks.text: Kitab yahan "BS Model" naam ki tasveer deti hai: binary system (BS) ke do black holes ek doosre ke gird ghoom rahe hain aur neeche spacetime ki jaali (grid) mur rahi hai.
4. Stochastic GWs

Stochastic GWs kamzor aur random (be-tarteeb) signals hain jo bohat se kamzor sources, jaise door ke binary systems, ki waves ke aapas mein milne (superposition) se bante hain. Inhein pakarna sab se mushkil hai.

Har accelerate karne wala object gravitational waves paida karta hai, gariyan aur hawai jahaz bhi. Lekin Zameen par cheezon ka mass aur acceleration itne kam hain ke un ki waves hamare instruments se pakri ja sakne jitni bari nahi hotin.

Jab binary systems (binaries) ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain to gravitational waves emit karte hain, jinhein LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory, USA) aur Virgo (Cascina, Italy ki bari observatory) jaisi observatories pakar sakti hain. Yeh waves system ke mass, spin aur merger (milap) ki information laati hain aur light ki speed se chalti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki tasveer
blocks.text: Ek hi centre wale spheres (gole) ka silsila, jis ke centre mein binary system hai; yeh gravity waves ko bahar cosmos (kaainat) mein phaila raha hai.
Binary systems gravitational waves ke bare sources hain, aur un ka merger (do bhaari objects ka takra kar ek zyada bhaari object ban jana) universe ke sab se intense events mein se hai.

Jab masses ghoomte aur accelerate karte hain to un ki gravitational intensity (shiddat) badalti hai, aur har direction (simt) mein bahar phailne wali waves banti hain. Yeh waves binary system ki gravity mein bound (qaid) nahi rehtin; light ki speed se spacetime mein freely (azadi se) chalti hain aur source se door jate hue kamzor hoti jati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki tasveer
blocks.text: Tidal forces gravitational waves ka mathematical signature (pehchan ka nishaan) rakhti hain.

blocks.alt: Two dark bodies orbiting each other at the centre of many concentric blue circles, with arrows pointing outward: gravitational waves spreading out from a binary system.
blocks.caption: Binary system se phailti gravitational waves (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan ek tasveer deti hai jis mein binary system centre (markaz) mein hai aur spheres (kurre) bahar phailte hain. Yeh saada khaaka wohi baat dikhata hai: do bhaari objects ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain aur un se waves light ki speed se har direction mein bahar jati hain, door ja kar kamzor hoti hain.
GWs ki characteristics system ki in baaton par depend karti hain:

items: orbit ki eccentricity: eccentricity ε batati hai ke rasta perfect circle (mukammal daire) se kitna hat-ta hai.

blocks.text: Spacetime distortion / tidal forces

Mass wale object se guzarne wali gravitational waves object ko baar baar khinchne aur dabne par majboor karti hain; isay “spacetime distortion” kehte hain. Is effect ko “tidal forces” bhi kehte hain aur yeh wave ke oscillating (jhoolne) ki wajah se hai. Wave object ke ird-gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, jis se object wave ki direction ke perpendicular baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai. Yeh waisa hi hai jaise Chand aur Suraj ki gravitational pull (kashish) se Zameen par samandar mein tides (madd-o-jazar) aate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki tasveer
blocks.text: Ek artificial (insaan ka banaya hua) aur ek natural satellite ke saath spacetime ka curve (jhukao).

blocks.alt: Four rings of small masses at t = 0, T/4, T/2 and 3T/4 as a gravitational wave passes into the page: a circle, an ellipse stretched sideways and squeezed vertically, a circle again, and an ellipse stretched vertically and squeezed sideways.
blocks.caption: Guzarti gravitational wave mein azad masses ka daira khinchta aur dabta hai (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Wave page ke andar ja rahi hai. Us ki direction ke perpendicular plane mein object ek taraf khinchta aur doosri taraf dabta hai, phir aadhe period baad ulta. Yahi baar baar khinchao aur dabao (tidal effect) hai.
Stretching aur compressing ki amount wave ki strength (taqat) aur object ke mass aur size par depend karti hai. Yeh effect Einstein ki general relativity ki ek important prediction hai.

Door ke celestial (falaki, aasmani) events, jaise do black holes ya neutron stars ke merger, ki waves Zameen se bhi guzarti hain. Lekin in ka amplitude bohat chhota hai (strain taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²²), is liye in se hone wali tabdeeli bohat hi chhoti hai aur extremely sensitive (bohat hassas) instruments chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab amplitude ko “10⁻²¹ to 10⁻²² metres” likhti hai. Gravitational wave ka amplitude strain hai, yani length mein fractional tabdeeli (ΔL/L), jis ka koi unit nahi. LIGO ke 4 km lambe arms mein yeh tabdeeli sirf taqreeban 10⁻¹⁸ m hoti hai (4000 m × 10⁻²¹).

blocks.title: Kitab ki tasveer
blocks.text: Do satellites ke zariye dikhaya gaya spacetime ka curve: bhaari gole ke gird jaali neeche jhuki hui hai.

Chhote amplitude ke bawajood gravitational waves universe ko dekhne ka unique (anokha) darwaza hain: in se strong-field gravity (bohat taqatwar gravity) parhi ja sakti hai, general relativity ko test kiya ja sakta hai, aur universe ko un tareeqon se dekha ja sakta hai jo pehle mumkin nahi the.

blocks.prompt: Gravitational waves kya hain, kis ne un ki prediction ki, aur tidal forces kaise bante hain (MCQ 8.10, 8.11, 8.13; constructed response 8.6)?
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves spacetime mein waves hain jin ki prediction Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein general relativity se ki; yeh zyada tar accelerate karte bhaari objects, jaise black holes ke merger, se paida hoti hain. Jab wave kisi object se guzarti hai to us ke gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, to object wave ki direction ke perpendicular baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai; yahi tidal forces hain, jaise Chand aur Suraj Zameen par tides banate hain.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Gravitational waves: violent cosmic events se spacetime mein waves, light ki speed se; Einstein ki 1916 ki prediction; pehli detection 2015 (do black holes ka merger).
Chaar types: continuous, compact binary inspiral, burst, stochastic. Binary systems sab se bare sources hain; waves mass, spin aur merger ki information laati hain.
Tidal forces: guzarti wave object ko us ki direction ke perpendicular khinchti aur dabati hai; strain sirf 10⁻²¹ ke qareeb, is liye LIGO jaise sensitive instruments chahiye.
